fit_for_shire: Static decorative props: garden tools, crockery, barrels, baskets, sacks, furniture, isolated rocks and landmark dressing after author review.

owner_override_2026_10_09.quality_note: Only provider-owned documentation and actually downloaded items are evidence; generated marketing previews are not production-ready proof.
owner_override_2026_10_09.quality_goal: Shire first scene should look natural and photo-real in-scene at 720p/30FPS target; supplier preview images are not Unreal screenshots.

selection_policy_2026_10_09.priority_1: Reuse existing approved/staged/licensed quality resources; prefer CC0 photorealistic and FBX before paying for generation.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.priority_2: Meshy official detailed 2026 FAQ grants up to 10 Meshy 6 Lite free downloads/month, but not regular Meshy 6/7; personal-home account eligibility and FBX quality not tested. Prefer no-account Poly Haven CC0 source assets for active production.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.priority_3: Tripo and Sloyd free account outputs for research/non-commercial comparisons only; paid terms require owner authorization and legal review.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.priority_4: RealityScan captures physical objects with mobile compatibility and subject permissions, convert Android GLB to FBX.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.priority_5: Fab free models on per-item license/engine-compatible basis; compare imported output with commercial plan where necessary.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.asset_pipeline: Static FBX; animated skeletal FBX; texture PNG/TGA packed; proper UV, normals, LODs, collisions, affordable geometry/2GB VRAM, no synchronous heavy asset load, HISM/object-pooling where appropriate.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.source_quality: Forum leads are advisory only, not provider/license proof; every practical source needs updated official evidence and exact item record.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.chapter_policy: P1C01 before P1C02; no Gate 6/7 claim from resource catalogue.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.no_gpu_prerequisite: No local image-to-3D model or additional GPU rental is authorized; web services may run on provider GPUs without project hardware, only if account/credits are available.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.highest_photorealism: Quixel Megascans via Fab photogrammetry is primary visual-realism benchmark when the specific item is free/legally accessible, downloadable as UE4-compatible FBX or convertible, and optimized. Poly Haven CC0 scanned assets are default zero-cost source.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.personal_home_use: Owner confirms PRIVATE_OFFLINE_NON_COMMERCIAL. Personal-only third-party licenses are permitted after quick explicit terms check; this does not waive copyright, site login requirements, paywalls, no-redistribution provisions or source attribution obligations.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.bible_anchor: SHIRE_JOURNEY_MASTER_EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_BIBLE_V1_2026-09-25.pdf (owner-provided, 225 catalogued sources) and 11_MASTER_PRODUCTION_SYSTEMS_AND_SOURCE_INDEX.pdf; prefer Priority A within each category.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.production_batch: First evaluate grounded candidate item URLs in Data/P1C01PhotorealSourcePilotV1.json; only stage acquired/downloaded assets after verifying item rights, actual FBX+PNG source, SHA256 and basic topology without new runtime build.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.model_quality_priority: First physically scanned, realistic models from Fab/Quixel Megascans and Poly Haven with bounded game triangles; AI promo visuals are not evidence of resulting meshes.
selection_policy_2026_10_09.offline_noncommercial_law: User owns private/noncommercial home project; private-only terms may permit local use if explicitly allowed. The original 225-source PDF and existing DEC-037 preserve access rights, attribution, and no redistribution of private media.
